title: Playtomic Manager — tools for sports-club operations
summary: Selected features in a team-built platform: payments, pricing rules, schedules, court management and a club TV interface.
description: I contributed selected features to Playtomic’s sports-club management tools, working on payment interfaces, pricing rules, schedules and court management. I also built and launched a club TV interface for match statistics, player standings and schedules.

sections.heading: The product context
sections.body: Playtomic Manager brings club operations into one platform. The official video linked above introduces its calendar and facility scheduling, customer management, competitions, academy tools and analytics. It is a broader product overview; my contribution covers the specific features described below.

sections.heading: Payments and configurable pricing
sections.body: I developed administrative payment interfaces and pricing rules based on date, area, sport and player count, supporting the different conditions under which a club sells access to its facilities.

sections.heading: Organizing the frontend around features
sections.body: I migrated payments, schedules and court management to a feature-based architecture, organizing these parts of the application around their business responsibilities.

sections.heading: A TV interface for the club
sections.body: I built and launched a sports-club TV interface showing match statistics, player standings and schedules, making this information available on screens at the club.

sections.heading: Investigating unreliable end-to-end tests
sections.body: I prototyped a Cypress API record/replay plugin to address backend timeout failures. I validated stability on two tests; this was a focused prototype rather than a rollout across the entire test suite.

sections.heading: My contribution and the public demo
sections.body: I worked at Playtomic from April 2020 to June 2022 as a Senior Frontend Developer. The video is a public overview of the broader product and may show changes introduced after my time there.
